skills.name: SLOW STARTER
skills.description: When RINTARO SUNA (Fireworks Festival) loses a debuff, his Quick ATK stat increases by {1}, up to a maximum of {2}. At the start of the match, RINTARO SUNA (Fireworks Festival) gains {3} stack(s) of the [Slacking Off] debuff, each stack reducing his Quick ATK stat by {4}%, up to a maximum of {5} stacks.

skills.name: PREDICTIVE BLOCK
skills.description: RINTARO SUNA (Fireworks Festival) performs a Block with with power equal to {1}% of his Block stat; each stack of the [Slacking Off] debuff increases the power of this block by {2}% of his Block stat.

skills.name: FEINT ATTACK POSTURE
skills.description: RINTARO SUNA (Fireworks Festival)'s Quick ATK stat increases by {1}% and his Block stat by {2} points.\nWhen RINTARO SUNA (Fireworks Festival) has a debuff, his blocks will be Critical.\nAt the start of the round, RINTARO SUNA (Fireworks Festival) removes {3} stack(s) of the [Slacking Off] debuff; after the [Slacking Off] debuff first falls below {4} stack(s), the maximum cooldown duration for UNEXPECTED SPIKE is reduced by {5} net crossing(s).

skills.name: UNEXPECTED SPIKE
skills.description: RINTARO SUNA (Fireworks Festival) performs a Quick Spike with with power equal to {1}% of his Quick ATK stat; after the [Slacking Off] debuff first falls below {2} stack(s), UNEXPECTED SPIKE ignores blocks, and the power of this spike increases by {3}% of his Quick ATK stat.

After the [Slacking Off] debuff first falls below {0} stack(s), RINTARO SUNA (Fireworks Festival)'s UNEXPECTED SPIKE is guaranteed to be Critical. Whenever he loses {1} debuff stack(s), the power of the spike increases by {2}% of his Quick ATK stat, up to {3}%, lasting until the next spike.

At the end of each round, if RINTARO SUNA (Fireworks Festival) has fewer than {0} stack(s) of [Slacking Off], he gains {1} stack(s) of [Slacking Off], each stack reducing his Quick ATK stat by {2}%, up to a maximum of {3} stack(s). When RINTARO SUNA (Fireworks Festival) touches the ball while having a debuff, his Strength increases by {4}%, lasting for {5} net crossings.

bonds.name: Fireworks Festival
bonds.description: SHINSUKE KITA (Fireworks Festival)'s Receive increases by {0} points. RINTARO SUNA (Fireworks Festival)'s Quick ATK increases by {1} points. The player who uses their Ultimate for the first time each round gains {2} stack(s) of the [Tranquil] debuff, each stack reducing Awareness and Reflex by {3}%, up to {4} stacks.
